abstract: A caller impersonating a prosecutor/investigator (검찰·수사관) says the victim is linked to a personal-data-leak or criminal case, threatens a summons, and demands details of the victim's bank and assets, steering them toward transfers for 'safety'.
safe_verification_channel: hang up and call the prosecutors' office or 금융감독원 1332 directly; agencies never ask for assets or transfers by phone
red_flags: asks for bank and asset details

abstract: The victim is told a credit card they never applied for has been issued/shipped; a fake 'card-company call center' number is given, and when the victim calls it the scammers (posing as the card firm, then the FSS/prosecutor) walk them into disclosing details or installing an app.
safe_verification_channel: look up the card company's official number yourself; never call back a number given in the alert

abstract: A caller offers a low-interest loan if the victim first 'repays' an existing loan or pays a fee, and asks for their debit card/bankbook or to install an app, harvesting banking access.
safe_verification_channel: contact your own bank via its official app; legitimate lenders never ask for your card/bankbook or upfront repayment
